notes.title: Games Forged in Germany has begun!
notes.content:
Hello, witches! 🧙‍♀️

REKA is part of the amazing Games Forged in Germany Steam event from 24th - 31st July! We're so happy and flattered to be able to share the spotlight over the next week with so many great games made in Germany! While we recommend checking out all of them, we’d like to take a moment and highlight a couple of our personal favourites from our friends.

Star Birds

First up is Star Birds! Toukana Interactive in collaboration with kurzgesagt created a relaxing asteroid base-building and resource management game which will release into Early Access later this year! Discover and mine countless asteroids, create production networks and guide your flock of spacefaring birds to new interstellar horizons. It's an amazing matchup of two amazing German studios so come to expect all the charm of a kurzgesagt video and the captivating gameplay Toukana is known to create. But don’t just trust our word, there is a demo available right now and you can visit them at their booth at Gamescom next month as well! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2719750/Star_Birds/?utm_campaign=ggember

Wanderburg

Planned to release in 2026 Randwerk has created a minimalist open-world roguelike in an ecosystem of Castles on Wheels. Consume, grow bigger, upgrade your modules, and survive! notes.title: Community Update: Sneak peeks & more!
notes.content:
Hello, witches! 

Summer solstice has arrived and warmer weather is now in full swing. With bees buzzing and flowers blooming, we wanted to give you a little update on the gardening content and what we're currently working on. ❤️

The Curious Case of the Little Straw Doll 🌾

Firstly, we noticed a few comments about the straw doll not working properly. We've looked into this and believe we have made a fix. This will need a bit more polishing down the line (we will explain below!), but for now it should work as intended.

Thank you SO much for bearing with us through these bugs. We're working as hard as we can to investigate issues as well as focus on new content, so sometimes things do take a little longer than we'd hope. 

The Little Straw Doll will work if you place the item into a pot or flower bed and will prevent your crops from rotting/growing any further. One important thing to note, if you want to move the straw doll to a different flower bed, you'll need to store it first. Otherwise, you can move it to a different location but the original flower bed will still be protected from rot. So please store the straw dolls before you move them. (We will work on ironing that out a little later down the line!)

From recipes to sewing projects, cute pictures of cats and book recommendations, there's channels for loads of hobbies and interests, and we love to chat about all of them!
Chat to the team behind REKA. While we're always active on Steam and our other socials, Discord is where you can see more behind-the-scenes and share your feedback directly with the dev group.

notes.title: Roots & Remedies Update Patch is now live!
notes.content:
Hello, witches!

Our Roots & Remedies Update Patch has been moved onto the main branch and is now ready for everybody to play!

This patch features lots of fixes and polishes that should make your time in the woodlands even more enjoyable! Thanks so much to everyone who tested this update on the Beta branch, it was super helpful.

You can read more on what's coming to the patch below, but first we'd like to mention a few important points: 

Siva Shrine: If you are on 'Becoming the Herbal Witch' but you still have an unfinished Siva shrine on your map, you can just travel to the next map. You have already completed it and don't need to do it again.
Or if you'd like to go with a save file where you haven't completed the shrine yet, talking to Baba Jaga will often help complete the quest.

Button Mapping: We have gotten reports of Button Mapping Settings changing randomly. If you are experiencing issues where some keys don't do what there supposed to please let us know and reset your Button Mapping Settings if needed.

Optimisation: From what players have reported, it should mostly be the first map in the tutorial of the game that is suffering with frame rate issues. This is unfortunate and we apologize, but from the second map onwards our testers have experienced the game running normally. We will continue to investigate ways to fix this, and want to thank you all for bearing with us!

notes.title: Dev Update: Upcoming Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Hello, witches! 

We just wanted to jump on here and firstly say a big thank you to everyone who has left us feedback since our Roots & Remedies Update launched. It's been really helpful in pointing us in the right direction of where we should be focusing our efforts. 

With your feedback we have already fixed the crows not collecting wood, so please do continue to let us know if you spot anything odd! (Click here to use our Bug Report form)

So, what's next for REKA? 

Our goal is for REKA to be a relaxing and immersive experience, and a game where you can escape and live your witchy life in the woodlands with your chicken-legged home. It's so important to us that REKA is an enjoyable experience for everyone, and we're taking your reviews and comments very seriously. 

While adding more content and story to REKA is still very much part of our plan for Early Access and beyond, we're going to be spending some time polishing and bug fixing to ensure you can play the game with as few hiccups as possible. 

Coming to our next patch, we're aiming to have ironed out:


 Fixed terrain level - No more floating or sunken assets!  
 Fixed items like the Pine Branch and Lantern getting stuck in hand 
 Fixed Lumberjacks vanishing from Trial of the Forest Spirit Clearing
 Drastically reduced time and resources needed at the beginning of the game when loading dependencies (This should help players who were having issues loading the game)
 Drastically reduced time taken to open the Journal, as well as a couple other journal tweaks. 

The latest with optimization  

We hear you. Throughout our journey developing REKA, optimization has presented us with a few unforeseen challenges. We've been working through this, but there is a much bigger problem which is causing performance issues with the first map.

From what players have reported, it should only be the first map in the tutorial of the game that is suffering with frame rate issues. This is unfortunate and we apologize, but from the second map onwards our testers have experienced the game running normally. We will continue to investigate ways to fix this, and want to thank you all for bearing with us! 

We're hoping to have this patch ready by end of next week, and we'll share more with you very soon. Thanks so much for all your support <3

Emberstorm x

notes.title: The Roots & Remedies Update is Out Now!
notes.content:
Hello witches!

It's finally here - our gardening update is ready to play! We've been so excited to share this content with you, and we can't wait to see your witchy gardens. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42492896/5aef7e8402201d900a6ffacac55dc67692faff6e.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42492896/4487bb1328e9af3ceaffffeebe2483716555a9ec.png

We've also added a feature we're very passionate about... Talking to the animals! Once you've brewed a special potion, you'll be able to speak with your furry and feathery companions for a short period of time. {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42492896/a9ec5014af6314a9aa248384afbdea8bfe3c11fb.gif

Join our wholesome community 

We're very lucky to have such a wonderful and interesting Discord community, and you're welcome to come join us! Head over to our Discord server to chat about REKA, your favourite books, share photos of nature, chat about pets, share recipes and more! 

You can also sign up to the Fireshine Games newsletter to hear about future playtests, competitions, and latest news.

Thanks so much for your continued support. We hope your have a relaxing and cozy time tending to your plants, and we look forward to the next update! 

Talk soon,

notes.title: Roots & Remedies Update is coming May 12th!

Thanks again for being such a wonderful community. Working on REKA has been our dream and we're so lucky to have you join us on this journey. <3

Talk soon!

A sneak peek at flax flowers!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42492896/e59e3890f001206e6529ecc570a7f859db6b8718.png 
To download the full recipe book, join us on Discord and head to the kitchen channel! 

We're part of the Games with Wings showcase! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42492896/104231962330951179203c8c296fd1dd645aaaa0.png

That's all for now, thanks so much for your continued support and we can't wait to show you more upcoming content very soon!

notes.title: The new patch is available on the Beta branch!
notes.content:
Hello witches! 🧙‍♀️

Our latest patch featuring loads of fixes and improvements is out now on the Beta branch! We really hope you'll enjoy the improvements we've made and that your journey through the woodlands will be an even better experience. 🧡

To read the full patch notes, click here. 

Please note: Your save files will be affected! 

For this patch only, due to a much bigger optimisation issue, your save file will be affected when you download this patch. Here's what will happen:
 
- You'll lose progress on any incomplete quests. If you haven't finished a quest, you'll have to start these from the beginning. (This includes the tutorial)
- House builds won't be affected. 

Here's what we'd recommend before downloading the patch: 

- Complete any outstanding quests. 
- Save your game and move to a new map. 
- More info on backing up your save can be found here.
- Download the patch on the Beta branch! 

We'd love for you to test this patch!

- Right-click REKA in your Steam library and select Properties.
- Go to the BETAS tab.
- Enter the code: REKAopenBeta in the Private Betas section, then click Check Code.
- Select Community Beta from the dropdown, update the game, and enjoy!
- Please note: If you notice your game looks a lower quality than usual, go into the Settings - Graphics -- Turn off Dynamic resolution.

We check Steam, our socials, and Discord regularly and are always tracking your feedback, but filling in this form is the best way to help us organise any bugs you spot: https://fireshinegames.jotform.com/242213662397357

Thank you for helping us improve REKA! Your feedback is invaluable as we continue working on the game. 🌿

notes.title: Patch Notes: REKA OPEN BETA UPDATE - 0.4.23.07219d
notes.content:
Here's the latest changes that have been added to the Beta branch for you to test. Thank you! <3

Changes:
- Optimized the way points of interest spawn, so that they are distributed further apart on the map

Performance:
- Slightly improved RAM usage by destroying submeshes of paths that are no longer necessary after the environment generation is completed
- Added  “Quadtree Culling” a system that disables Meshes based on distance and where the player is looking
- Decreased size of Save Files so new saves you create from now on will load faster
- Added new Performance Settings
* Cloth Simulation Quality
* Render Distance
(Note: This will only take effect if you set it from the menu, restart the game or travel to another area.)
* Grass Distance
* Grass Density
* Reimplemented Dynamic Resolution Settings
* Implemented point light culling at 50m

Fixes:
- Fixed Button Remapping not working with controller
- Fixed various bugs in the button remapping screen
- Fixed the loot you receive from bludnik shrine only being fly agaric mushroom after a while
- Fixed Raven Coat and other wearables vanishing (it should reappear if you have completed the quest)
- Fixed a bug where you sometimes couldn’t walk through your doors in the chicken hut
- Fixed a bug that caused the screen to flicker, when near the mirror
- Fixed spamming Escape while jumping forward freezing the game
- Fixed outfit “Layered Burgundy Gown With Lace Accents” missing arm decorations
- Fixed outfit “Layered Burgundy Gown With Lace Accents” sleeves clipping through some coats
- Removed deprecated Hairstyle “Two short braids”. If you have previously selected this hairstyle, you will now be bald and can choose a new hairstyle at the mirror
- Removed deprecated shoes slippers. If you have previously selected these shoes, you will now be barefoot and can change your shoes at the mirror
- Fixed a bug that would cause paths to lower the terrain under Points of Interest, causing some objects to float
- The “three crowns” and “plon” book now have the correct icons when receiving them or viewing them in the building UI
- The “sparkling” effect will now properly fade until no longer visible over some distance
- Fixed a bug that could cause multiple Points of Interests to spawn on top of each other
- Fixed Candle Maker behaving weirdly, swallowing items, or not working at all
- Fixed not getting your wax back when storing a candlemaker
- Made error message when you cant store something more apparent
- Fixed a bug that would cause the grass to jitter, when standing on it for longer than 15 seconds
- Fixed the collisions between the Abandoned Mirror Point of Interest and the Chicken Legged Cottage. - You can no longer walk through the building with your chicken legged cottage
- Fixed a bug that could cause two babushkas to spawn in the same place, making it impossible to interact with one of them
- Fixed a bug where players could add more than 1 item to bludnik shrine
- Guidance popups for active quest, travelling and cooking will now not show again after loading a save if you have seen them already.
- Fixed a variety of saving & quest bugs
- Fixed not being able to cleanse the graveyard after saving and loading in tutorial.
- Fixed a saving bug in the Forgetful Villager Quest
- Fixed the deer group not saving correctly
- Fixed the mirror reflection causing flickering
- Fixed a bug that caused villagers heads to disappear
- Fixed a bug that would cause the “Pick Up” prompt to remain, when bringing a hare home, resulting in the carry animation to break when interacting with it.
- Fixed a bug that caused the player to not get a pine branch from a crooked pine while also removing the branch from the tree, if their inventory was full.
- Fixed being able to double dip on the lutkis. You now have to decide whether to do the offering or take back the loghive.
- Fixed behavior of the merchant’s scale
- Fixed various bugs concerning the villagers requesting food

notes.title: An important update about REKA!
notes.content:
Hello, witches!

We hope you are all keeping well and enjoying the winter season. ❤️

We wanted to give you a little update on where we’re at with our bug fixes and a little insight into the future of REKA. We know so many of you are eager to find out what’s coming next and we want to be as transparent as possible with what to expect. 

Bug fixing and optimisation: 
As you know, we are working on the fixes for the Halloween update as well as general optimisation issues. The good news is that we’ve sorted the issues you were experiencing with The Witching Hour (including the Bludnik only giving mushrooms as rewards and the candle making table will be easier to use!). 

Unfortunately, we can’t release this patch as soon as we’d hoped. We were aiming to release this patch by the end of the year, however while we were making all these fixes and improvements, we found a much bigger optimisation issue which we need to address before releasing any patches. Fixing this bigger issue will make future game updates much easier for us to implement, as well as improving the overall optimisation and health of REKA. 

With this in mind, the next patch will be coming in January. We’re so sorry for any disappointment this causes, but please know we are working super hard to fix this. We are a small dev team so it takes a little longer for us to investigate issues and figure out how to fix things – but we’re so close to getting to the bottom of this now! 

A look into the future:
Your feedback has been so helpful to us since our launch into Early Access. Reading through all your comments and reviews has shown us what’s important to you and where we should be putting more content into REKA. We’ve decided to make changes to our roadmap to reflect features you’ve been requesting. 

We’ll be able to share more with you in the new year, but we wanted to let you know about a feature we’re very excited about and currently working on… 

In 2025 a big content update will be coming to REKA, and it will include gardening! Gardening is something that fits perfectly into the cozy vibes of our game and we can’t wait to see how creative you can be with it. 👨‍🌾✂️🌳

Thank you so much for bearing with us through everything, your support has been amazing and we’re feeling so positive about the future of REKA. 

Any questions please let us know and we’ll do our best to answer! Many thanks ❤️

Emberstorm x

Thanks again for your support, and as soon as we have an update on the Bludnik's infinite mushroom supply we'll let you know!

notes.title: The Witching Hour: Update notes (0.3.4.3e733f)
notes.content:
New Content:

•	Introduced Bludniks

 Creatures from Slavic mythology that will lead you into the swamp to find valuables. Provide offerings to these ghostly like creatures to receive loot!
 Will spawn on every sandbox map.

•	Added Enchanted Candlemaker:

 This new crafting station will let you create candles and also change their colours depending what ingredients you add! Try adding berries and black salt and see what creations you can make.

•	Babushka Stories:

 Three Babushkas with some haunting stories will spawn in the villages. Find them and hear what tales and warnings they have for you.

•	Reforestation:

 Trees will now need to be replanted after harvesting too many. If you cut down too many trees without regrowing any, Leshy will appear and take away your ability to cut down more. 
 There will be a larch tree with sap and cones on every sandbox map.


•	Wearables:
  A new slavic themed outfit has been added! Including: 
    Headpiece
    Cape
    Outfit
    High Boots (brown and black)
    Long Fingernails (red)

 Floating Candles

QOL:

 You can now have more than 3 save files, and you will now be prompted which save you would like to make or override.

 Instead of removing house piece by piece, you can now deconstruct your house entirely. Talk to Baba Jaga if you wish to begin designing your perfect home from scratch.
 If there is not enough room in the inventory to fit:
•	Wood from the house building blocks
•	Items that you have in chests
•	Other building blocks

•	Added fog of war to the minimap:

 Now you will be able to more easily see which areas of the world you have visited, and which are still to be uncovered.
 If you walk with the chicken hut, the fog will only be partially revealed

notes.title: REKA Update - 8th of October - V0.1.136.422387
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We’ve combined two previous Open Beta updates into one comprehensive patch to make sure you’re all up to date with the latest changes and fixes. This update includes improvements from both patches, so if you’ve missed anything along the way, you can catch up now!

Check out the full details below, and as always, thank you for all the feedback and support in helping us make REKA the best it can be!

Back up your save!
We also want to encourage everyone to back up any existing save files from the previous version just to be safe. You can do that by following the steps seen below;

- Create a save file: Start the game and manually save. You can find your saves by pressing WindowsKey+R and then typing in %AppData%\RekaGame\Saves and pressing ok.

- Back up your save: Make a copy of the save folder and paste it in a safe location, like your desktop or another folder.

- Restore if needed: If you encounter any issues after installing the latest patch, simply replace the new save files with the backup you made.

Gameplay Changes
 Your chicken hut’s feather color is now saved. For older save games, you’ll see a popup allowing you to restore your chosen feather color.

notes.title: Community Update: Pre-Launch FAQ
notes.content:
Happy September, witches! 🎃

Autumn is almost here and we’re so excited for burnt orange leaves, long woodland walks, and cozy nights in with a good book. There’s only one thing we’ve been eagerly anticipating more… The Early Access launch of REKA on September 12th! 

Ahead of our release day, we wanted to cover a few of your questions we’ve seen popping up.

What will be the Early Access price of REKA?
For launch week, we’ll have a 10% discount. Normally, the price will be £15.99 / $19.99 / €19.99. 

How long will REKA be in Early Access?  
We can’t yet give a definitive date as this will largely depend on community feedback, however REKA will be in Early Access for the remainder of 2024, with 1.0 launching in 2025. 

What’s the expected length of the Early Access version of the game?
REKA is being designed as a cozy, open world experience, so it's difficult to put an exact number on game length. From our own internal play sessions, we have seen a variety in playtime, depending on how each person chooses to play the game. To get the full REKA experience, our recommendation is to take your time exploring the woodlands, speaking to villagers, solving quests and building out your chicken-legged cottage. In a relaxed playthrough of the initial Early Access launch content, we'd estimate this to be roughly 6-8 hours.

We have designed REKA as a story-rich experience where players are encouraged to immerse themselves into the world, and while it's possible to rush through certain moments, doing so will naturally lead to a shorter playtime. More content, including new quests, will be coming throughout Early Access, and we hope you enjoy the beginning of REKA's journey!

Will there be Steam Achievements?
Steam Achievements are something we’re working on, but they won’t be ready for Day 1 of Early Access. We’ll let you know when they are being added. 

Will REKA be Steam Deck Compatible?
REKA won't be verified for EA launch, but we are looking into Steam Deck requirements and hope to be verified within our journey into 1.0. We'd recommend playing on PC to get the full experience. 

Will progress carry on from the demo?
Progress will not carry over from the demo/playtests, so you'll need to start from the beginning. 

What content is coming to the 1.0 launch? 
We’re working on our roadmap to launch as we speak and we’re aiming to share something with you very soon showing the vision of REKA. Expect new quests, continued story, more furniture items, new features such as crafting, and of course bug fixing! 

Going into Early Access allows us to work with you to create a game we hope you’ll love. Your feedback is so important to us, so if there’s something you really want to see, please let us know! To leave us feedback, we're most active on Discord, but we do check all our social media, as well as our Steam forums.

If there’s anything else you’d like to find out, please ask away in the comments!

A big thank you for all your continued support. You’ve been such a wonderful community, and we can’t wait to finally share our game with you. 🔮

If you’d like to chat with the devs, meet other players, and be part of exclusive competitions, come join us on Discord!

Talk soon,

Having our demo live is always such an exciting experience for us as we love reading through your comments. To keep things all in one place and to make it a little easier for you, we wanted to cover off some questions we've seen popping up recently...

Frequently Asked Questions 

When is REKA launching?
Announced during the PC Gaming Show, our new trailer revealed that REKA is launching in August. This is a little later than we had originally planned, but we wanted to make sure we had enough time to polish our game and implement important feedback we received from our playtests. Thank you so much for your ongoing support, we can't wait to finally show you more of our game! 🍄

Will REKA have Steam Deck support?
We don't have official Steam Deck support yet, but this is something we are looking into for Early Access. We can't say for sure whether this is something we will have Day 1 for launch, but this is ideally what we are working towards. 

Will there be voice acting?
Voice acting is not currently planned. We're always open to hearing community requests, however voice acting would be a pretty big one for us to do as a small indie studio. We've been focusing our efforts on the exploration and house-building aspects of REKA, and we hope that the world will still feel immersive without VO. 

Can we stream the demo?
Yes, please feel free to make content from the demo. Unless it's a closed playtest, we're happy for you to stream our game. 🔮

There's optimisation issues with the demo, are these being fixed?
We're aware of the problems with optimisation, and thank you so much for flagging them! Optimisation is a big focus for us in the run up to launch, and our team is working hard to iron out these issues and make improvements. 

Is the demo localised?
Our demo is not localised at the moment. We're still working through translations, and currently our demo is only playable in English. Very sorry if you're unable to play because of this. 

What languages will REKA be localised in?
For Early Access, REKA will be playable in English, French, German, Spanish, Polish, Russian, and Ukrainian.

Will there be controller support?
Controller support is something we are working on, and ideally hoping to have ready for Early Access. We will keep you updated with our progress on this!

notes.title: Community Update: Early Access
notes.content:
Hi everyone 🧡

Today we have two very important updates we’d like to share with you. Firstly:
 
REKA will be coming to Steam Early Access in Q2 of 2024! We’re so thankful for this community, and our #1 goal is to deliver the best version of our game possible. This feels like the right step for REKA, and we can’t wait for your chicken-legged journey to begin!  
 
Secondly, REKA was part of the OTK showcase today and we unveiled a brand-new trailer! This gives you a sneak peek at what's to come in the Early Access version of REKA, as well as some unseen gameplay: 

[previewyoutube=lNzk9TC1iHc;full][/previewyoutube]
 
If you have any questions about these announcements, we’ve prepared a little FAQ below. Thanks so much for all your continued support, we’re sure you’ll make wonderful apprentices to Baba Jaga! 
 
The Emberstorm devs 🧡 

Why is REKA going into Early Access?   
Early Access will allow us to work with our community to shape REKA and create a memorable experience for all who play. Your feedback from our playtest was exactly what we needed, and reading about what you enjoyed and what you’re hoping to see in the full game was incredibly helpful. We're a small team of 4 full-time devs, so being able to include our players in REKA's development journey is invaluable to us! ✨ 
 
We’re continuing to work on some of the suggestions we’ve already seen in the Discord (we’ve had a lot of members asking about character customisation!) and it’s a lovely way for us to progress, knowing we’re improving aspects of the game that are important to you. 🧙‍♀️ 
 
Behind the scenes we have also focused our efforts on the house-building elements. Designing and decorating the chicken-legged cottage is a key part of REKA, and one we know many of you are looking forward to in the full release. This is something we want to make sure isn’t rushed, and we’re hoping Early Access will help us refine this aspect of the game! 🐔 
  
From our player surveys, we’ve also noticed just how much interest there was in the narrative and lore for REKA. Since then, we have decided to collaborate with an award-winning writer to bring the storyline to life. We’re so excited about this and will be sharing more very soon.  
 
We look forward to continuing to develop REKA with our community at the heart of what we do. ❤️ 

How long will REKA be in Early Access? 
Although we can’t give a definitive date, we anticipate that REKA will be in Early Access development for the majority of 2024. We will be closely reviewing community feedback to help determine this. 
 
Will the game be priced differently during and after Early Access? 
During Early Access, we’ll be adding more content to the game and overall improving the experience. Therefore, we do expect the price to increase as we go into full release. We’ll give plenty of notice when this is likely to happen.   

What will be the difference between the Early Access version and full version of REKA? 
We’re planning on releasing REKA’s prologue and chapter one for Early Access launch. For 1.0 launch, the remaining chapters and REKA’s complete story will be available! 📚 
 
We plan to add new areas, quests, recipes, items and more with each update.  We’re aiming for these updates to bring other elements too, like new accessories for your witch, furniture and side quests! We’ll share a roadmap closer to Early Access launch which will show you the new and exciting content that’s being added to the game. 

How will you involve the community in the development process?

Discord is our primary area to directly talk to our community and receive feedback, so we would like to encourage everyone to share their ideas in the suggestion-cauldron channel.  

We’ll also continue to monitor feedback and communicate updates directly onto our other social channels, including the Steam forums and X (Twitter).  

You can join our Discord here. 
 
Hopefully this has helped to clear up any queries, but if you have any other questions, please do let us know! 🧡
